svg.title: x-change g-clef pulley — standalone symbol
svg.desc: x-change g-clef pulley mark variant. Treble clef drawn as rigging: a shackle, two multi-sheave pulley blocks, rope and a lifting hook. Reconstructed as vector outlines; contains no text.

g.data-element: continuous clef linework: shackle, pulley blocks, rope and hook
pulley block rivets and bolt holes
rope hatching between the pulley blocks
